Every sampled action receives signal despite zero immediate reward at first two.

**Countercase / boundary:** Gamma0 gives returns[0,0,8] and logits[0,0,.4]. If the first action is declared irrelevant to the terminal outcome, this sampled-return update still reinforces it; receiving credit is not proof of causal contribution or a variance-free estimate.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether first sampled action receives zero update at gamma.5; recall gamma.25 gives first return.5 and first logit.025 under the same episode.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Back up one step at a time then Apply updates shows reward, return and separate action probabilities on one timeline; Gamma0 and Irrelevant first action expose limits while retaining original signals. Show raw episode before prediction, not computed returns.
